short.prompt: Summarize unified memory in one sentence.

medium.prompt: Explain how unified memory affects model loading, prompt prefill, and token decoding on Apple Silicon. Include the main performance tradeoffs and keep the answer under six paragraphs.

long.prompt: You are reviewing a local Apple Silicon inference service. Analyze a design with two resident MLX language models, a deterministic capability-aware router, per-session stickiness, shared generation slots for overlapping nodes, and fallback only before response headers. Discuss correctness invariants, memory pressure, queueing, TTFT, prefill, decode throughput, cancellation, observability, and a practical validation plan. Be precise about which conclusions require real hardware measurements.
